sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – full-volume two-year proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. Our orders for this seal on 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-21 were both at EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10).

We propose EUR 29.89/unit for the full 23,400 pcs/year, with a 24-month commitment and a 56-day lead time. Other terms: effective 2027-01-01, DAP, 30 days net, no index clause and no tooling.

The full two-year commitment gives you firm, long-term volume. The 56-day lead time gives you scheduling room to plan your allocation.

What adjustment would make this package workable for you?

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – full-volume two-year proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We note your reference to past orders; however, current capacity utilization dictates our updated pricing structure. 

We can accommodate the increased volume of 23,400 pieces and the 24-month contract term with a 56-day lead time. In consideration of this extended commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.90 per unit.

Our updated Angebot comprises a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm (part:340010) – full allocation, three-year commitment, 42-day delivery
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming the full 23,400 pcs/year and the 24-month term.

We would like to propose a complete package that gives you more firm business. We raise our proposed price to EUR 31.60/unit and extend the commitment to 36 months at the full 23,400 pcs/year. In exchange, we ask for a 42-day lead time. Other terms stay unchanged: effective 2027-01-01, DAP, 30 days net, no index clause and no tooling.

The third committed year gives you long-term volume to plan your capacity around. The 42-day schedule is what our production needs.

Can this complete package work for you?

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm (part:340010) – full allocation, three-year commitment, 42-day delivery
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We offer a price of €31.90 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23,400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

Without movement from your side we cannot move either. The contract term is reflected in the price. A shorter Lieferzeit means overtime; that is priced in. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Furthermore, which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.
